witches.name: Seraphine Vale
witches.title: The Crimson Daughter
witches.description: Seraphine Vale is one of the most powerful blood witches recorded in Hexarium. Born beneath a crimson eclipse, she learned to manipulate the invisible bonds between blood, memory and magic. Her spells are extraordinarily powerful, but every ritual demands a price.

witches.name: Isolde Briar
witches.title: Keeper of the Wild Garden
witches.description: Isolde Briar lives within the ancient gardens of Briarwood, where plants are said to grow according to her moods. She is renowned for her healing remedies, rare botanical knowledge and poisons that leave almost no trace.

witches.name: Amara Rose
witches.title: The Velvet Enchantress
witches.description: Amara Rose is an enchantress whose magic is woven through emotion, memory and desire. Although her spells are rarely violent, the ability to influence another person's feelings has made her one of the most carefully observed witches in the archive.

witches.name: Selene Mourne
witches.title: Keeper of the Crescent
witches.description: Selene Mourne serves as High Priestess of the Lunar Order. Her magic changes with the phases of the moon, reaching its strongest state beneath a full moon. She is known throughout Hexarium for visions that have predicted events decades before they occurred.

witches.name: Lyra Nocturne
witches.title: The Weaver of Dreams
witches.description: Lyra Nocturne learned to cross the boundary between dreams and waking life at an unusually young age. She can enter another person's dreams, uncover hidden memories and construct illusions indistinguishable from reality. Her whereabouts are currently unknown.

witches.name: Sera Vale
witches.title: The Crimson Daughter
witches.description: Seraphine Vale is one of the most powerful blood witches recorded in Hexarium. Born beneath a crimson eclipse, she learned to manipulate the invisible bonds between blood, memory and magic. Her spells are extraordinarily powerful, but every ritual demands a price.

spells.name: Whisper of the Moon
spells.chant: Luna, veil of silver light, reveal what sleeps beyond my sight.
spells.description: Reveals fragmented visions beneath strong moonlight, allowing the caster to glimpse possible paths hidden within the near future.

spells.name: Root Bind
spells.chant: Root and thorn beneath the ground, rise and hold what I have bound.
spells.description: Calls living roots from the earth to restrain a target until the spell is released or the roots are broken.

spells.name: Crimson Oath
spells.chant: By crimson thread and willing vein, let spoken vows in power remain.
spells.description: Creates a powerful magical bond between those who willingly swear an oath beneath the same sigil.

spells.name: Dreamwalk
spells.chant: Through sleeping veil and silent stream, open now the gates of dream.
spells.description: Allows the caster to enter the dreamscape of a sleeping person and move through fragments of their subconscious.

spells.name: Veil of Shadows
spells.chant: Shadow gather, candle fade, hide my form within the shade.
spells.description: Wraps the caster in shifting darkness, making their form difficult to perceive in dimly lit surroundings.

spells.name: Tempest Call
spells.chant: Wind awaken, heavens roar, gather storm from distant shore.
spells.description: Summons turbulent winds and charged clouds around the caster, building into a localized magical storm.

spells.name: Tidekeeper's Grace
spells.chant: Tide surround and waters rise, guard my path beneath the skies.
spells.description: Forms a protective veil of water around the caster that softens impacts and offers resistance against heat and flame.

spells.name: Astral Passage
spells.chant: Body rest and spirit rise, carry me beyond these skies.
spells.description: Separates the caster's spirit from their physical body for a limited journey through the astral plane.

spells.name: Roseheart Charm
spells.chant: Rose and honey, heart made bright, soften words in gentle light.
spells.description: Creates a gentle aura of warmth and trust around the caster, encouraging openness without controlling another person's will.

spells.name: Gravewhisper
spells.chant: Those who linger, those unseen, whisper through the veil between.
spells.description: Allows the caster to hear faint echoes left behind by spirits connected to a particular resting place.

spells.name: Ember Ward
spells.chant: Ember circle, flame defend, let no wicked power enter in.
spells.description: Creates a ring of glowing embers that repels minor hostile magic and burns away weak curses.

spells.name: Bloomwake
spells.chant: Seed awaken, root arise, bloom beneath the open skies.
spells.description: Accelerates the growth of nearby plants, causing dormant leaves, vines and flowers to awaken.

spells.name: Mirror of Truth
spells.chant: Silver surface, clear and bright, strip away deceiving sight.
spells.description: Reveals magical disguises, concealed enchantments and illusions reflected within a prepared mirror.

spells.name: Frostbound Sigil
spells.chant: Winter answer, silence grow, seal this mark in frost and snow.
spells.description: Places a freezing sigil upon a surface that releases a burst of magical frost when disturbed.

spells.name: Echo of the Forgotten
spells.chant: Memory sleeping, memory gone, return your echo before the dawn.
spells.description: Draws forth fragments of memories attached to an object, location or lingering magical presence.

spells.name: Serpent's Remedy
spells.chant: Venom drawn and poison flee, leave this flesh and come to me.
spells.description: Draws poison and minor magical toxins from the body and transfers them into a prepared herbal vessel.

spells.name: Starlight Beacon
spells.chant: Star above and spark below, light the path that I must know.
spells.description: Creates a floating celestial light that guides the caster toward a chosen person, place or magical signature.

spells.name: Blackthorn Hex
spells.chant: Thorn and shadow, twist and turn, let hostile power falter and burn.
spells.description: Places a lingering curse upon a target that causes hostile magic they cast to become unstable and difficult to control.

spells.name: Seafoam Passage
spells.chant: Sea receive me, tide be kind, grant me breath where waters bind.
spells.description: Allows the caster to breathe beneath water and move through deep currents with supernatural ease.

spells.name: Crown of Lightning
spells.chant: Storm above and spark within, crown me where the skies begin.
spells.description: Channels electrical energy around the caster in a luminous crown that can release controlled arcs of lightning.
